'''Quartz''' was a common mineral composed of [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]] and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. [[Zeka quartz]] was a variety.

There was an outcropping of quartz on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
